items.reason: A gentle cleanser with no active ingredients is a good fit for a young person starting a simple face-washing habit.

response.routine_note: Wash your face gently with lukewarm water once or twice a day and pat dry; you don't need anything else right now. We left out exfoliating acids, retinoids and scrubs because they aren't suited to younger skin, and a grown-up can help you choose if you want to add a product later.
